algorithm: sha256 of the subtree printed by jq -cS (sorted keys, no whitespace, trailing newline); fileSha256 is the sha256 of the stored file bytes

adaptations: None for the codec: the hosted diene_problems 0.1.1 decodes and encodes each valid envelope back unchanged.
Every member a port problem puts on the wire must appear in the sample envelope. Port problems never set instance; 0.1.1 always writes recoverable and data, and port problems always carry data.
The sample data ({ id, resource } for entity-not-found) is not compared: that shape belongs to diene_problems, and port problems carry { port, code, operation } plus details.
The id is spelled in snake case: entity-not-found becomes entity_not_found, in the id and in the last segment of the expected URI; the hosted 0.1.1 builder rejects the kebab-case id.
Port problems are minted on the sample's portal and version, with the id replaced by <port>_<code> (for example vfs_not_found); everything before the last segment must equal the expected URI.
